FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Technical Strength Above MA20 Amid Mixed China Data and Geopolitical Tension
tldr_points: China’s June retail sales and industrial output beat expectations, supporting risk-on sentiment.
Price trades above the 20‑day MA at 162.04 vs 161.88, with RSI near neutral 53.
Geopolitical escalation in the Gulf introduces safe‑haven bias, but the technical upside bias remains.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY shows modest bullish bias as price holds above MA20 amid better‑than‑expected China data and regional tensions.
FX.comment: USD/JPY shows modest bullish bias as price holds above MA20 amid better‑than‑expected China data and regional tensions.
